verdict.rationale: The docs show OAuth client-credentials grant for short-lived tokens and separate SDK tokens for capture flows, which provides some credential separation, but there is no explicit mention of scoped/least-privilege roles, permission granularity, or agent-specific credential issuance. missing for 10: explicit least-privilege/scoped role definitions, documentation of granting narrower API scopes per use-case or agent, and any AI-agent-specific credential workflow.
